name: Speak with Sevren
summary: In Brill, Magistrate Sevren calls you north after Coleman Farthing's reckoning at Agamand Mills. The undead there threaten the settlement's northern border.

sections.title: From Vengeance to Civic Duty
sections.body: Coleman Farthing wanted revenge on his former neighbors, the Agamands, and sent travelers north to kill the undead around their flour mills. After you delivered the remains, Coleman saw that his private grudge touched a wider danger. The Agamand estate still crawls with aggressive Scourge minions, close to Brill.

sections.title: The Magistrate's Call
sections.body: Magistrate Sevren oversees Brill's civic and military security for the Dark Lady. Reports say you survived deep incursions into the haunted farmlands, and Sevren now directs you toward the source of the infestation: the ancient Agamand family crypt.

faq.q: Why does Coleman Farthing send me to Magistrate Sevren?
faq.answer: Coleman settled his vengeance against the resurrected Agamand family, but the undead at the mills threaten all of Brill. He told Magistrate Sevren of your skill in battle, and Sevren directs Brill's defense.

faq.q: Where can Magistrate Sevren be found?
faq.answer: Magistrate Sevren is in Brill, Tirisfal Glades, inside Brill Town Hall, where he directs local affairs for the Forsaken.

faq.q: What threat do the Agamand Mills pose?
faq.answer: Agamand Mills lies just north of Brill and remains infested by mindless Scourge. The dead and restless spirits in the fields could overrun the town if left unchecked.

faq.q: What happens after speaking with Magistrate Sevren?
faq.answer: Magistrate Sevren sends you into the Agamand Family Crypt to strike at the deeper Scourge threat anchoring the undead to the mills.

faq.q: Does this quest require returning to the mills immediately?
aliases: do i go back to the mills
faq.answer: You report to Sevren in Brill to conclude Coleman's lead before taking on the next mission into the crypt.

faq.q: Why does Brill care about the Agamand family?
aliases: who are the agamands to brill
faq.answer: The Agamands were wealthy mill owners and prominent neighbors in Tirisfal. In death, their estate is a fortified staging ground for mindless Scourge.

angles.text: As an Undead, proving yourself against the mindless Scourge earns recognition in Brill and brings you from odd jobs into direct civic defense under Magistrate Sevren.
As a member of the Horde, you help defend Brill, the first line before the Undercity. Securing the farmland from the Scourge protects the Horde's hold on northern Lordaeron.
